method: Real WASD plus native captured joystick for fine corner control; Chromium touch emulation, NOT a physical device. Declared independent review-scene starts; continuous motion WITHIN each case; final full bridge outward/return is continuous. No in-movement teleport/collision override or movement-speed changes. A* gives intended waypoints; native contact and rendered-body evidence reported separately.

legs.failure: Native joystick unavailable for real fine input
